subtitle: When the River Turned Against the Fort

panels.shot: epic wide of Chaliyam fort at the river mouth, tiny against a looming fleet and hillside guns
panels.action: The Zamorin & Kunjali III stand on a bluff above the Chaliyar mouth, silhouettes against monsoon clouds, watching cannons and war-boats encircle the Portuguese fort like a tightening noose.

dialogue.text: In 1571, at Chaliyam, a stone pistol aimed at Calicut’s throat met the patient fury of the Zamorin and Kunjali III—and the whole Indian Ocean watched.

i18n.hi: १५७१ में चालियाम पर, कालीकट के गले पर रखी पत्थर की पिस्तौल का सामना ज़मोरिन और कुंजाली तृतीय के धीरज भरे गुस्से से हुआ—पूरा हिन्द महासागर देख रहा था।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye of the Malabar coast with Calicut, Beypore and Chaliyam marked by ships and river mouths
panels.action: A sweeping coastal vista shows the curve of Malabar, Calicut’s bustling harbour, the shipyards of Beypore, and the small but menacing Portuguese fort at Chaliyam gripping the river mouth.

dialogue.text: For the Portuguese, Chaliyam was a key lock on Malabar; for the Zamorin, it was a pistol pressed against Calicut’s shipbuilding heart by foreign hands.

i18n.hi: पुर्तगालियों के लिए चालियाम मलाबार की कुंजी था; ज़मोरिन के लिए, यह कालीकट के जहाज़ी दिल पर पराया हाथ रखा हुआ पिस्तौल था।

panels.shot: low-angle on the Portuguese fort, stout walls facing river and sea, guns protruding
panels.action: The fort of Chaliyam rises grim and compact on the sand spit, cannon mouths jutting over the Chaliyar, a few European soldiers on the parapet scanning the water with wary eyes.

dialogue.text: Built near Beypore’s river mouth, the fort let Portuguese guns watch every mast and plank that fed Calicut’s trade, a constant reminder of Lisbon’s reach.

i18n.hi: बेयपोर की नदीमुख पर बना किला पुर्तगाली तोपों को हर मस्तूल और तख़्त पर नज़र देता था—कालीकट की रफ्तार पर लिस्बन की पकड़ का रोज़ का इशारा।

panels.shot: interior court scene, medium shot of the Zamorin in council with Kunjali III leaning over a coastal map
panels.action: Inside the Zamorin’s hall at Calicut, The Zamorin & Kunjali III bend over a painted map of Malabar; the king sits firm on his throne while the sea commander points at Chaliyam with a resolute hand.

dialogue.text: By 1571, after decades of trading, raiding and treaties, the Zamorin’s patience frayed. Chaliyam, more than any fort, felt like a hand round his neck.

i18n.hi: १५७१ तक, सालों की मंडी, लूट और समझौते के बाद, ज़मोरिन का सब्र टूटने लगा। चालियाम, किसी भी किले से ज़्यादा, उसके गले पर कसता पंजा लग रहा था।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Kunjali III’s face, intense but controlled, sea wind visible through an open lattice
panels.action: Kunjali III, bearded and weathered by sea and war, looks out through a lattice at monsoon clouds over the Arabian Sea, his jaw set, fingers resting on the hilt of a sword.

dialogue.speaker: Kunjali III
dialogue.text: My lord, as long as Chaliyam stands, every ship that leaves our river sails under their shadow.

i18n.hi: स्वामी, जब तक चालियाम खड़ा है, हमारी नदी से निकला हर जहाज़ उनकी परछाईं के नीचे ही चलेगा।

panels.shot: wide shot of a diplomatic assembly, messengers from Deccan sultanates and other Indian powers with scrolls
panels.action: In a larger hall, The Zamorin & Kunjali III receive envoys clad in varied Deccan styles, bearing seals and letters; behind them hang banners suggesting alliances across the Indian Ocean.

dialogue.text: Beyond Malabar, a wider League of the Indies stirred—Deccan sultans, the Red Sea and Persian Gulf ports, all wary of Portuguese control. Chaliyam became a shared test.

i18n.hi: मलाबार से आगे, पूरा ‘लीग ऑफ़ द इंडीज़’ जाग रहा था—दक्कन के सुल्तान, लाल सागर और फ़ारस की खाड़ी के बंदरगाह, सब पुर्तगाली हुक्म से खफ़ा। चालियाम सबका इम्तिहान बन गया।

panels.shot: dramatic planning table shot, cannons and boats sketched on palm-leaf plans
panels.action: The Zamorin & Kunjali III lean over palm-leaf plans showing riverbanks dotted with cannon symbols and lines of war-boats; retainers place small stones to mark positions along the Chaliyar.

dialogue.text: This time, the Zamorin would not rush the walls and bleed against European guns. He would starve the fort, seal the river, and let hunger do what cannon could not.

i18n.hi: इस बार ज़मोरिन यूरोप की तोपों पर सिर नहीं फोड़ेगा। वह किले को भूखा रखेगा, नदी बंद करेगा, और भूख से वो कराएगा जो गोले नहीं कर पाए।

panels.shot: epic riverside wide of Malabari artillery emplacements, cannons being hauled into position by men and oxen
panels.action: Along the muddy banks near Chaliyam, Malabari soldiers and labourers strain as they drag heavy bronze cannons into fresh earthworks, while The Zamorin & Kunjali III ride along the line overseeing placements.

dialogue.text: Tuhfat al-Mujahidin speaks of forty cannons bristling along the Chaliyar—whether rounded or exact, the riverbank now answered stone with steel.

i18n.hi: तुफ़त अल-मुजाहिदीन चालियार किनारे सजी चालीस तोपों का ज़िक्र करता है—गिनती चाहे जो हो, अब नदी का किनारा पत्थर का जवाब लोहे से दे रहा था।

panels.shot: dynamic shot of Kunjali III aboard a war-boat leading a flotilla, oars poised, ships behind
panels.action: Kunjali III stands at the prow of a sleek Malabari war-boat, arm raised, as a line of oared vessels fans out to form a blockade across the river mouth under grey monsoon light.

dialogue.text: On the water, Kunjali III’s boats became a moving wall. From July, no sail could slip food or powder to Chaliyam without passing his guns.

i18n.hi: पानी पर कुंजाली तृतीय की नौकाएँ चलते-फिरते किले बन गईं। जुलाई से कोई पाल उसके तोपों से गुज़रे बिना चालियाम तक रोटी या बारूद नहीं पहुँचा सकता था।

panels.shot: inside the Portuguese fort, medium shot of Dom Jorge de Castro looking out, thin garrison behind him
panels.action: Within the cramped courtyard of Chaliyam fort, Dom Jorge de Castro stands tense, watching from the parapet as enemy entrenchments grow; behind him, weary Portuguese soldiers cluster around dwindling supplies.

dialogue.text: Inside, commander Dom Jorge de Castro saw the trap closing. His garrison was small, his supplies finite, his nearest help far over hostile waters.

i18n.hi: अंदर, सेनापति दोँ जॉर्ज दे कास्त्रो जाल सिमटता देख रहा था। उसकी टुकड़ी छोटी थी, रसद कम, और मदद दुश्मन समंदर के पार बहुत दूर।

panels.shot: nighttime shot of cannons firing from the riverbank toward the fort, flashes lighting rain
panels.action: Under a driving night rain, earthen batteries along the river erupt in orange flashes as cannons roar toward the fort; the fort’s silhouette answers with its own bursts in the storm-dark.

dialogue.text: Artillery duels lit the monsoon nights. Malabar guns hammered the walls, Portuguese pieces replied, but the deeper wound was the silent blockade around them.

i18n.hi: तोपों के दंगल ने बरसाती रातें रोशन कर दीं। मलाबार की बंदूकें दीवारों को पीटतीं, पुर्तगाली जवाब देते—पर असली घाव था चारों तरफ़ पसरी ख़ामोश नाकाबंदी।

panels.shot: interior close-up of Portuguese stores: near-empty barrels, worried faces of soldiers
panels.action: Inside a dim storeroom, soldiers lift the lids of grain barrels to find only a thin layer remaining; one man counts cartridges while another leans against the wall, hollow-eyed and exhausted.

dialogue.text: Week by week, the fort’s strength thinned. Food ran low, powder dwindled, disease crept through the cramped rooms as the siege stretched into months.

i18n.hi: हर हफ़्ते किले की ताक़त गलती गई। राशन घटा, बारूद कम पड़ा, बीमारियाँ तंग कमरों में फैलती गईं, और घेरा महीनों तक खिंच गया।

panels.shot: wide sea shot of distant Portuguese ships turned back by Malabari presence and monsoon
panels.action: Far out on the heaving sea, a small formation of Portuguese vessels hesitates against heavy surf and sighted Malabari craft, their sails reefed as they struggle to approach the river mouth.

dialogue.text: Portuguese India knew Chaliyam was under attack, but the monsoon seas, local resistance and the Zamorin’s fleets made relief costly and uncertain.

i18n.hi: पुर्तगाली भारत जानता था कि चालियाम घिरा है, पर मानसून का समंदर, स्थानीय बगावतें और ज़मोरिन के बेड़े मदद भेजना महँगा और अनिश्चित बना रहे थे।

panels.shot: medium shot of the Zamorin on a hilltop command post, calm amidst reports, Kunjali III beside him
panels.action: On a hill overlooking the siege, The Zamorin & Kunjali III listen as scouts report Portuguese weakness; the Zamorin’s face is calm, his fingers resting on prayer beads, while Kunjali’s gaze burns toward the fort.

dialogue.text: From July to November, the Zamorin did not rush the outcome. Every day his guns spoke, his boats watched, and the fort’s circle of options grew smaller.

i18n.hi: जुलाई से नवंबर तक ज़मोरिन ने नतीजे पर जल्दबाज़ी नहीं की। रोज़ उसकी तोपें बोलती रहीं, नावें निगरानी करती रहीं, और किले की गुंजाइश छोटी होती गई।

panels.shot: tense parley scene at the fort gate between Malabari envoys and a drawn, proud Dom Jorge
panels.action: At the battered fort gate, Malabari envoys stand firm under flags, facing a worn but straight-backed Dom Jorge de Castro; the walls around them bear scars of cannon impacts and months of strain.

dialogue.text: At last, with his men weakened and no relief in sight, Dom Jorge faced the choice every fortress dreads: resist to ruin, or surrender and face Lisbon’s anger later.

i18n.hi: आख़िरकार, कमज़ोर सैनिकों और दूर की मदद के बिना, दोँ जॉर्ज उस फ़ैसले पर आ पहुँचा जिससे हर किला डरता है: आख़िरी साँस तक लड़ो, या आत्मसमर्पण कर के बाद में लिस्बन का कोप झेलो।

panels.shot: somber interior of the fort as Portuguese soldiers lay down weapons, Malabari troops entering
panels.action: In the courtyard, Portuguese soldiers stack muskets and pikes with grim faces as Malabari troops step in cautiously, the tension thick but the killing stayed.

dialogue.text: In November 1571, the garrison at Chaliyam surrendered. The pistol at Calicut’s throat was finally taken from Portuguese hands by siege, not storm.

i18n.hi: नवंबर १५७१ में चालियाम की टुकड़ी ने हथियार डाल दिए। कालीकट के गले पर रखी पिस्तौल आँधी नहीं, घेराबंदी से पुर्तगालियों के हाथ से छिन गई।

panels.shot: dramatic wide of the fort being demolished: walls collapsing, workers dismantling stone
panels.action: Under clear post-monsoon skies, labourers and soldiers pry stones from the fort’s walls, topple bastions, and level earthworks until only rubble remains where the stronghold once stood.

dialogue.text: The Zamorin ordered the fort demolished. Piece by piece, its walls came down, so no foreign power could again sit so close over Calicut’s river mouth.

i18n.hi: ज़मोरिन ने किले को ढहाने का आदेश दिया। ईंट दर ईंट दीवारें गिराई गईं, ताकि फिर कोई परायी ताक़त कालीकट की नदीमुख पर इतनी पास आकर न बैठ सके।

panels.shot: contrast shot: Goa’s grand Portuguese buildings and ships, showing their continued presence
panels.action: Far away, a view of Goa shows sturdy churches, fortifications and anchored carracks, busy with priests, merchants and soldiers, signaling an enduring Portuguese stronghold.

dialogue.text: Yet Chaliyam’s fall did not end Portuguese rule. Goa, Diu and other strongholds remained, reminding all that this was a hard-won check, not a final victory.

i18n.hi: फिर भी चालियाम का पतन पुर्तगाली राज का अंत नहीं था। गोवा, दीव और अन्य क़िले अब भी खड़े थे—याद दिलाते हुए कि यह कड़ा पलटवार था, आख़िरी जीत नहीं।

panels.shot: heroic riverside wide of the Zamorin and Kunjali III overlooking a free river mouth with local boats
panels.action: The Zamorin & Kunjali III stand on the shore near Beypore as local boats glide freely across the Chaliyar mouth, shipwrights at work behind them and the former fort site reduced to a quiet stretch of sand.

dialogue.text: Tuhfat al-Mujahidin made Chaliyam its climax, and Portuguese chronicles recorded Dom Jorge’s later execution for surrender. The river remembers that patient pressure, not sudden glory, reshaped power on Malabar’s coast.

i18n.hi: तुफ़त अल-मुजाहिदीन ने चालियाम को अपना चरम बनाया, और पुर्तगाली इतिहास ने आत्मसमर्पण पर दोँ जॉर्ज की बाद की फाँसी दर्ज की। नदी गवाही देती है कि मलाबार के किनारे ताक़त बदलने वाली चीज़ अचानक शौर्य नहीं, धीमी, अडिग दबाव था।

subtitle_i18n.hi: जब नदी ने किले से बगावत की
